project.name: nvim-pack
project.description: Neovim configuration managed by nvim-pack — an opinionated Lua-driven editing environment bundling 118 plugins

nodes.label: .luarc.json
nodes.summary: Lua Language Server (lua_ls) configuration for the nvim-config project. Sets runtime version to LuaJIT, configures workspace libraries (luv, busted, luassert from 3rd party and ./local lua), excludes .worktrees/.superpowers/.ua/.jj directories, and declares global symbols (PackageManager, PluginsLoader, snacks, Snacks, vim) for the linter.
nodes.name: file:.luarc.json

nodes.label: .neoconf.json
nodes.summary: Neoconf plugin configuration that enables neodev for enhanced Lua LSP support (library and plugins enabled) and activates the lua_ls plugin through neoconf. This augments the base .luarc.json configuration with neovim-specific Lua API knowledge.
nodes.name: file:.neoconf.json

nodes.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor onboarding guide for nvim-config. Lists prerequisites (Neovim and Jujutsu), provides clone instructions from github.com/jolafrite/nvim-config.git, and documents the startup command (nvim -u ./init.lua).
nodes.name: file:CONTRIBUTING.md

nodes.label: KEYMAP.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive keymap reference for the nvim-config Neovim configuration. Documents all keybindings organized by category: movement & display, window & pane, lines & editing, search, files, diagnostics, LSP on_attach, Snacks picker, Git, terminal, quickfix/loclist, Trouble, Flash, Yanky, Format (conform), Completion (neocodeium), Noice, Todo comments, Grug far, Treesitter textobjects, Snacks toggles, Which-key, and filetype-specific bindings. Leader key is comma. Source files include lua/config/keymaps.lua and multiple lua/plugins/*.lua files.
nodes.name: file:KEYMAP.md

nodes.label: LSP_CONFIG.md
nodes.summary: LSP server configuration reference generated from nvim-lspconfig source. Lists approximately 400 language servers with their cmd, filetypes, root_markers, settings, and init_options. Each row maps languages to an LSP server and shows the key Lua configuration fields used with vim.lsp.config(). Includes a deprecated servers section at the end.
nodes.name: file:LSP_CONFIG.md

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.summary: Project root README for nvim-config. Contains only the project title heading. The full project description is provided by the parent agent context: a Neovim configuration managed by nvim-pack, bundling 118 plugins for an opinionated Lua-driven editing environment.
nodes.name: file:README.md

nodes.label: nvim-pack-lock.json
nodes.summary: nvim-pack lock file pinning 118 Neovim plugins with their git revision and source URL. Includes core plugins (blink.cmp, treesitter, lualine, conform, snacks, neo-tree, which-key, gitsigns, noice, flash, yanky, trouble, conform, neocodeium, mason, nvim-lspconfig, nvim-dap, etc.) and their transitive dependencies. This is the authoritative manifest of the bundled plugin set.
nodes.name: file:nvim-pack-lock.json

nodes.label: selene.toml
nodes.summary: Selene Lua linter configuration targeting the vim Lua dialect (std = vim). Permits specific lint patterns: mixed_table, multiple_statements, global_usage, unused_variable, and shadowing are all set to allow, reflecting the coding conventions of this Neovim config which uses idiomatic Vim Lua patterns.
nodes.name: file:selene.toml

nodes.label: stylua.toml
nodes.summary: Stylua Lua formatter configuration. Sets column width to 160, Unix line endings, space indentation with width 2, AutoPreferSingle quote style, no call parentheses, always collapse simple statements, and enables sorted requires. Defines the canonical code style for all Lua files in this project.
nodes.name: file:stylua.toml

nodes.label: vim.yml
nodes.summary: Vim filetype detection and global type declarations for the Lua runtime used by Neovim. Sets base to lua51 and lua_versions to luajit. Declares typed globals (PluginsLoader, PackageManager, Snacks, vim, jit, bit, assert, package, table, string, os) with any: true, providing type information for the Lua LS when editing Neovim startup and plugin code.
nodes.name: file:vim.yml

nodes.summary: Neovim shared data archive (shada) file storing persistent editor state including command history, search history, registers, marks, and bookmarks across sessions. Binary format.
nodes.name: file:.local/nvim/shada/main.shada

nodes.summary: Neovim configuration entry point. Loads the utils module, config submodules (options, keymaps, autocmds), initializes the plugin loader and package manager, and sets the colorscheme to shades-of-purple.
nodes.name: file:init.lua

nodes.summary: Autocmd configuration module. Defines autoreload augroup for file change detection on focus/terminal events, filetype-specific conceallevel settings for json/jsonc/markdown, formatoptions cleanup on buffer enter, cursorline auto-hide during insert mode, and relative number toggling based on mode.
nodes.name: file:lua/config/autocmds.lua

nodes.summary: Keymap configuration module. Defines 50+ vim.keymap.set bindings across normal, insert, visual, and operator modes covering window navigation, search, diagnostics, file operations, flash navigation, snacks picker shortcuts, and leader-key workflows. Includes helper functions for URL opening, diagnostic jumping, and location/quickfix list toggling.
nodes.name: file:lua/config/keymaps.lua

nodes.summary: Vim options configuration module. Sets editor preferences including backspace behavior, clipboard mode, folding configuration via treesitter, smooth scrolling, spell checking, and window options. Configures root directory detection spec for project navigation. Overrides vim.keymap.set to enforce silent mode. Enables win32 PowerShell terminal integration.
nodes.name: file:lua/config/options.lua

nodes.summary: Health check module for nvim-pack. Validates Neovim version is 0.12 or later, checks for required external executables (git, make, unzip, rg), and reports system information. Returns a table with a check function compatible with vim.health API.
nodes.name: file:lua/health.lua

nodes.summary: Lualine statusline component for displaying plugin pack status. Extends lualine.component to show an animated spinner during package checking and a pending update count when packages are outdated. Registers a User autocmd for PackStatusChanged events to trigger statusline refreshes.
nodes.name: file:lua/lualine/components/pack.lua

nodes.summary: Snacks.nvim plugin configuration. Sets up the snacks framework with bigfile, indent, input, notifier, scope, scroll, statuscolumn, toggle, and words modules. Configures the picker with custom cwd-toggling action, dashboard with preset keybindings, and registers 40+ keymaps for picker, git, terminal, toggle, and debug workflows. Integrates with gitsigns for toggle integration.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/00-snacks.lua

nodes.summary: actions-preview.nvim plugin configuration. Sets up the plugin with snacks backend and dropdown layout preset. Registers a leader-key binding for previewing code actions in visual and normal modes.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/actions_preview.lua

nodes.summary: blink.cmp autocomplete plugin configuration. Integrates colorful-menu.nvim for enhanced popup rendering, configures completion sources (lazydev, LSP, dadbod, snippets, path, buffer), sets up cmdline completion, and triggers build with pwait for native compilation. Depends on blink.lib, blink.indent, blink.pairs, blink-cmp-git, lazydev.nvim, and vim-dadbod-completion.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/blink.lua

nodes.summary: conform.nvim formatter configuration. Sets up format-on-save with a Lua parseability guard that prevents formatter errors on incomplete code. Provides toggleable format-on-save via leader-key binding, manual format command, and a BufWritePre autocmd with async formatting and 1-second timeout.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/conform.lua

nodes.summary: Core plugin definitions for shared dependencies. Registers nui.nvim (UI component library) and plenary.nvim (Lua utility library) as non-lazy foundational plugins used by other plugin configurations.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/core.lua

nodes.summary: cyberdream.nvim colorscheme plugin registration. Adds the cyberdream theme as a non-lazy plugin for immediate loading at startup.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/cyberdream.lua

nodes.summary: nvim-dap (Debug Adapter Protocol) configuration. Sets up DAP UI with custom control icons, virtual text for variable display, auto-open/close behavior on terminate events, and 12 keybindings for debugging workflows including continue, step, breakpoint management, and REPL access. Depends on nvim-nio, nvim-dap-ui, nvim-dap-virtual-text, and nvim-dap-python.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/dap.lua

nodes.summary: e-ink.nvim colorscheme plugin registration. Adds the e-ink theme as a non-lazy plugin for immediate loading at startup.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/e-ink.lua

nodes.summary: fidget.nvim plugin configuration. Registers the LSP progress notification plugin, loaded on LspAttach event with default setup.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/fidget.lua

nodes.summary: flash.nvim fast navigation plugin configuration. Registers the plugin for all filetypes and sets up 6 keybindings for flash jump, treesitter flash, remote flash, treesitter search, and incremental selection workflows.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/flash.lua

nodes.summary: gitsigns.nvim git integration plugin configuration. Configures custom sign glyphs for git diff indicators and sets up 15 keybindings on buffer attach for hunk navigation, staging, resetting, blaming, and diffing. Integrates with snacks for toggle functionality.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/gitsigns.lua

nodes.summary: grug-far.nvim search and replace plugin configuration. Sets up the plugin with header max width of 80 and registers a leader-key binding for transient search/replace with file filter prefill based on current buffer extension.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/grug-far.lua

nodes.summary: indent-blankline.nvim indentation guide plugin configuration. Sets up vertical indent markers with custom glyph characters and configures scope highlighting for specific tree-sitter node types (return_statement, table_constructor).
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/indent-blankline.lua

nodes.summary: indent-o-matic automatic indentation detection plugin configuration. Sets up the plugin with skip_multiline enabled, triggered on all file types via utils.on_file_types helper.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/indent-o-matic.lua

nodes.summary: kulala.nvim HTTP client plugin configuration. Sets up global keymaps with leader-R prefix, configures node path resolver for script execution, and registers the plugin as non-lazy.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/kulala.lua

nodes.summary: Angular language support configuration. Registers mason tools (angular-language-server, prettierd, oxlint), configures angularls LSP with ngserver command for TypeScript/HTML filetypes, adds prettierd formatter and oxlint linter for htmlangular filetype, installs treesitter parsers for angular and scss, and sets up file-type autocmds for Angular component files.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/angular.lua

nodes.summary: Ansible language support configuration. Registers nvim-ansible plugin with mason tools (ansible-language-server, ansible-lint), configures ansiblels LSP for yaml.ansible filetype, adds ansible_lint linter, and provides a leader-key binding to run Ansible playbooks/roles.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/ansible.lua

nodes.summary: Astro language support configuration. Registers mason tools (astro-language-server), configures astro LSP with astro-ls command for astro filetype, adds prettierd formatter, installs treesitter parsers for astro and css, and registers astro snippets.

nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/lua.lua

nodes.summary: Configures Markdown language support with marksman LSP, prettierd/markdownlint-cli2/markdown-toc formatters, markdownlint-cli2 linter, and treesitter
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/markdown.lua

nodes.summary: Configures Nix language support with nil_ls LSP, nixfmt formatter, statix linter, and treesitter
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/nix.lua

nodes.summary: Configures Nushell language support with nushell LSP (nu --lsp) and treesitter
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/nushell.lua

nodes.label: ocaml.lua
nodes.summary: OCaml language support plugin. Registers ocamllsp LSP server via mason, configures it for ocaml/ocaml.interface/reason/dune filetypes with root markers including dune-project and *.opam, adds treesitter parsers for ocaml and ocaml_interface, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/ocaml.lua

nodes.label: odin.lua
nodes.summary: Odin language support plugin. Registers ols LSP server and odinfmt formatter via mason, configures ols with init_options for collections, document symbols, semantic tokens, and inlay hints, adds odinfmt as the formatter for odin files, adds treesitter parser for odin, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/odin.lua

nodes.label: php.lua
nodes.summary: PHP language support plugin with conditional LSP selection. Reads vim.g.lazyvim_php_lsp to choose between phpactor (default) and intelephense. Registers phpactor/php-cs-fixer/phpcs/php-debug-adapter via mason, adds php_cs_fixer formatter and phpcs linter, adds php-debug-adapter debugger and php snippets, configures the selected LSP server with composer.json root markers, adds treesitter parser for php.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/php.lua

nodes.label: prisma.lua
nodes.summary: Prisma schema language support plugin. Registers prisma-language-server via mason, configures prismals LSP with schema.prisma root markers, adds treesitter parser for prisma, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/prisma.lua

nodes.label: python.lua
nodes.summary: Python language support plugin with conditional LSP selection. Reads vim.g.python_lsp to choose between pyright (default) and basedpyright. Registers the LSP, ruff, and debugpy via mason. Configures pyright/basedpyright with detailed Python analysis settings (autoSearchPaths, diagnosticMode), configures ruff as a separate LSP with error-level logging, attaches an LspAttach autocmd to disable ruff hoverProvider, adds treesitter parsers for python/ninja/rst, adds ruff formatter with custom args, adds ruff/mypy/flake8 linters, adds debugpy debugger and python snippets, enables both LSP servers.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/python.lua

nodes.label: r.lua
nodes.summary: R language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers R.nvim plugin with neotest-testthat dependency, triggers on r/rmd/quarto filetypes. Config function sets up R.nvim with custom keymaps (localleader groups for all/between/chunks/functions/goto/install/knit/paragraph/quarto/r general/split or send/terminal/view), R_args, and pdfviewer settings. Uses utils.on_file_types to lazily enable r_language_server LSP. Adds treesitter parsers for r/rnoweb and registers neotest-testthat tester adapter.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/r.lua

nodes.label: rego.lua
nodes.summary: Rego (Open Policy Agent) language support plugin. Registers regols LSP server and regal linter via mason, configures both LSP servers for rego filetype, adds treesitter parser for rego, and enables both LSP servers.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/rego.lua

nodes.label: ruby.lua
nodes.summary: Ruby language support plugin with conditional LSP and formatter selection. Reads vim.g.ruby_lsp to choose between ruby_lsp (default) and solargraph, and vim.g.ruby_formatter to choose between rubocop (default) and standardrb. Registers the LSP, rubocop, standardrb, erb-formatter, and erb-lint via mason. Configures the selected LSP with Gemfile/Rakefile root markers. Conditionally configures rubocop as an LSP when rubocop is the formatter and solargraph is not the LSP. Adds treesitter parser for ruby and registers formatters for ruby/eruby.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/ruby.lua

nodes.label: rust.lua
nodes.summary: Rust language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers rustaceanvim plugin with crates.nvim dependency, triggers on rust filetype. Config function registers rust-analyzer and codelldb via mason, adds codelldb debugger, adds treesitter parser for rust. Conditionally configures bacon-ls diagnostics when vim.g.lazyvim_rust_diagnostics is set to 'bacon-ls'. Deep-extends rustaceanvim global settings with on_attach keymaps (codeAction, debuggables), rust-analyzer cargo/checkOnSave/diagnostics/procMacro settings, file excludes (target, node_modules, .git, etc.), and watcher config. Sets up crates.nvim, conditionally starts rustaceanvim LSP for current buffer, adds rustfmt formatter with custom args, adds clippy linter (with ignore_exitcode override), adds rust snippets, and registers rustaceanvim.neotest tester adapter.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/rust.lua

nodes.label: scala.lua
nodes.summary: Scala language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers nvim-metals plugin with plenary.nvim dependency, triggers on scala filetype. Config function adds treesitter parser for scala, conditionally requires metals and configures it with bare_config, sets detailed metals settings (verboseCompilation, showImplicitArguments, showImplicitConversionsAndClasses, showInferredType, superMethodLensesEnabled, excludedPackages, testUserInterface), and attaches a FileType autocmd for scala/sbt to initialize or attach metals.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/scala.lua

nodes.label: solidity.lua
nodes.summary: Solidity language support plugin. Registers solc compiler via mason, adds forge_fmt formatter for solidity. Conditionally configures solidity_ls LSP only when solc is executable, with foundry.toml/hardhat.config root markers. Adds treesitter parser for solidity.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/solidity.lua

nodes.label: sql.lua
nodes.summary: SQL language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers vim-dadbod plugin with vim-dadbod-ui and vim-dadbod-completion dependencies, triggers on sql filetype. Config function adds a keymap for DBUI toggle, registers sqls LSP and sqlfluff linter via mason, configures sqls LSP with config.yml root markers, adds sqlfluff formatter with ansi dialect args, adds sqlfluff linter, adds sql snippets, adds treesitter parser for sql, and enables sqls LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/sql.lua

nodes.label: svelte.lua
nodes.summary: Svelte language support plugin. Registers svelte-language-server, prettierd, and oxlint via mason. Adds prettierd formatter and oxlint linter for svelte, adds svelte snippets. Configures svelte LSP with a dynamic cmd function that checks for a local svelteserver binary in node_modules/.bin before falling back to the global binary via rpc.start. Adds treesitter parser for svelte and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/svelte.lua

nodes.label: tailwind.lua
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS language support plugin. Registers tailwindcss-language-server, prettierd, and stylelint via mason. Adds prettierd formatter for html/css/less/sass/scss/stylus, adds stylelint linter for css/less/sass/scss/stylus, adds snippets for the same filetypes. Configures tailwindcss LSP with broad filetype coverage (html, css, js, ts, svelte, astro, templ, php, blade, mdx) and custom includeLanguages settings for elixir/eelixir/heex. Enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/tailwind.lua

nodes.label: terraform.lua
nodes.summary: Terraform and HCL language support plugin. Registers terraform-ls LSP and tflint linter via mason. Configures terraformls LSP for terraform/terraform-vars filetypes with .terraform/.git root markers. Adds terraform_fmt formatter (via terraform fmt) for terraform/tf/terraform-vars, adds packer_fmt formatter (via packer fmt) for hcl, adds tflint and terraform_validate linters, adds treesitter parsers for terraform and hcl, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/terraform.lua

nodes.label: tex.lua
nodes.summary: LaTeX/TeX language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers vimtex plugin, triggers on tex/plaintex/bib filetypes. Config function registers texlab LSP via mason, configures vimtex compiler method (tectonic), disables K keymapping, sets quickfix method based on pplatex availability, configures texlab LSP with .latexmkrc/texlabroot/Tectonic.toml root markers, adds treesitter parsers for bibtex and latex, and enables texlab.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/tex.lua

nodes.label: thrift.lua
nodes.summary: Thrift IDL language support plugin. Registers thriftls LSP server via mason, configures it for thrift/thrift2 filetypes, adds treesitter parser for thrift, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/thrift.lua

nodes.label: toml.lua
nodes.summary: TOML language support plugin. Registers taplo LSP server and formatter via mason, configures taplo LSP with .taplo.toml/taplo.toml root markers, adds taplo formatter for toml files, adds treesitter parser for toml, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/toml.lua

nodes.label: twig.lua
nodes.summary: Twig template language support plugin. Registers twiggy-language-server, twigcs linter, and twig-cs-fixer formatter via mason. Configures twiggy_language_server LSP for twig/html.twig filetypes. Adds twig-cs-fixer formatter with custom config args, adds twigcs linter, adds treesitter parser for twig, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/twig.lua

nodes.label: typescript.lua
nodes.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript language support plugin. Uses require('utils').gh to build GitHub URLs. Registers oxlint, oxfmt, prettierd, and js-debug-adapter via mason. Adds treesitter parsers for typescript/tsx/javascript. Configures ts_ls LSP with detailed inlay hints settings for both typescript and javascript (enumMemberValues, functionLikeReturnTypes, parameterNames, parameterTypes, propertyDeclarationTypes enabled; variableTypes disabled), with tsconfig.json/package.json/jsconfig.json root markers. Configures oxlint LSP with fixKind=all for js/ts/json/vue/svelte/astro filetypes. Adds prettierd formatter and oxlint linter for js/jsx/ts/tsx, adds js-debug-adapter debugger, adds snippets for js/jsx/ts/tsx, enables both LSP servers. Also registers better-type-hover plugin with a Ctrl-P keymap for enhanced type display.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/typescript.lua

nodes.label: typst.lua
nodes.summary: Typst document preparation language support plugin. Registers tinymist LSP server and typstyle formatter via mason. Configures tinymist LSP with typst.toml root markers, single_file_support enabled, and formatterMode set to typstyle. Adds typstyle formatter for typst files (registered twice with different conform config approaches, including a default_format_opts extension). Adds treesitter parser for typst and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/typst.lua

nodes.label: vue.lua
nodes.summary: Vue.js language support plugin. Registers vue-language-server via mason, adds vue snippets, configures vue_ls LSP with vue.config.js root markers, adds treesitter parsers for vue and css, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/vue.lua

nodes.label: xml.lua
nodes.summary: XML language support plugin. Registers xmlformatter and lemminx LSP server via mason. Adds xmlformatter formatter for xml files, configures lemminx LSP for xml/xsd/xsl/xslt/svg filetypes with .git root markers, adds treesitter parser for xml, and enables the LSP.
nodes.name: file:lua/plugins/lang/xml.lua

nodes.label: yaml.lua
nodes.summary: YAML language support plugin. Registers yaml-language-server via mason. Configures yamlls LSP with custom capabilities (foldingRange with dynamicRegistration=false and lineFoldingOnly=true), a before_init function that uses schemastore to extend YAML schemas, and detailed settings (redhat telemetry disabled, yaml keyOrdering=false, format enabled, validate true, schemaStore disabled with empty url). Adds treesitter parser for yaml and enables the LSP.

edges.reason: Both files define the Lua runtime environment for Neovim. .luarc.json declares diagnostics globals (PackageManager, PluginsLoader, snacks, Snacks, vim) while vim.yml declares typed globals (PluginsLoader, PackageManager, Snacks, vim, jit, bit, assert, package, table, string, os). They are complementary configurations for the same Lua LS ecosystem.

Both files configure lua-language-server. .luarc.json is the base Lua LS configuration, while .neoconf.json enables neodev for enhanced Neovim API knowledge on top of the base config. They work together to provide complete Lua editing support.

.luarc.json references third-party Lua libraries (luv, busted, luassert) in its workspace.library setting. These libraries are dependencies managed by nvim-pack and listed in the lock file. The ./lua entry also points to the project's own Lua source.
.neoconf.json enables neodev for lua_ls, and the neodev library (lazydev.nvim) is listed as a dependency in the nvim-pack-lock.json. The neoconf plugin itself manages this integration.

vim.yml declares globals (Snacks from snacks.nvim, PackageManager and PluginsLoader from nvim-pack) that are provided by plugins pinned in nvim-pack-lock.json. The type declarations reference symbols exported by the bundled plugin set.

KEYMAP.md documents keybindings for over 20 plugins that are pinned in nvim-pack-lock.json, including snacks.nvim, gitsigns.nvim, flash.nvim, which-key.nvim, neo-tree.nvim, neocodeium, conform.nvim, noice.nvim, todo-comments.nvim, trouble.nvim, nvim-treesitter-textobjects, yanky.nvim, and more. The keymap reference is derived from the installed plugin set.

LSP_CONFIG.md is generated from nvim-lspconfig, which is pinned in nvim-pack-lock.json. It also references mason.nvim and mason-lspconfig.nvim from the lock file. The LSP server catalog depends on the installed nvim-lspconfig version.

Both are Lua development tooling configurations. stylua.toml defines the code formatter style and selene.toml defines the linter rules. Together they enforce consistent Lua code quality standards for the project.
stylua.toml defines Lua code formatting standards and .luarc.json defines the Lua language server configuration. Both are part of the Lua development toolchain for this Neovim config.
selene.toml defines Lua linting rules and .luarc.json defines the Lua language server diagnostics configuration. Both contribute to Lua code quality enforcement in the project.

Both are top-level project documentation files. CONTRIBUTING.md provides contributor onboarding instructions while README.md provides the project overview. They form the public-facing documentation for the nvim-config repository.

README.md describes the nvim-config project which is built around the 118 plugins pinned in nvim-pack-lock.json. The lock file is the concrete manifest of the plugin ecosystem described in the README.
CONTRIBUTING.md references the GitHub repository (github.com/jolafrite/nvim-config.git) which contains the nvim-pack-lock.json. Contributors need the lock file to reproduce the exact plugin set.

vim.yml provides filetype detection and typed global declarations for the vim Lua runtime, while .luarc.json provides the Lua LS workspace configuration. Together they form the complete Lua editing environment for Neovim plugin development.

stylua is the Lua formatter configured by stylua.toml. While stylua itself is not a pinned plugin in the lock file, it is referenced in LSP_CONFIG.md as a Lua LSP server (stylua --lsp) and is part of the project's Lua tooling ecosystem that supports the bundled plugins.

selene is the Lua linter configured by selene.toml. The selene-3p-language-server is listed in LSP_CONFIG.md as an LSP server for Lua. It is part of the project's Lua quality tooling that applies to the bundled plugins' Lua code.

KEYMAP.md documents LSP-related keybindings (gd, gr, gI, gy, K, <leader>ca, <leader>rn, etc.) that operate through the LSP servers catalogued in LSP_CONFIG.md. The keymap section on LSP on_attach references capability-guarded bindings that depend on the configured LSP servers.

sql.lua calls require('utils').gh to build GitHub plugin URLs for vim-dadbod and its dependencies, exported from lua/utils/init.lua.

svelte.lua calls PackageManager.add_with_mason, PackageManager.add_formatter, PackageManager.add_linter, PackageManager.add_snippets, and PackageManager.add_with_treesitter, defined in lua/utils/package_manager.lua.
tailwind.lua calls PackageManager.add_with_mason, PackageManager.add_formatter, PackageManager.add_linter, PackageManager.add_snippets, defined in lua/utils/package_manager.lua.
terraform.lua calls PackageManager.add_with_mason, PackageManager.add_formatter, PackageManager.add_linter, and PackageManager.add_with_treesitter, defined in lua/utils/package_manager.lua.
tex.lua calls PackageManager.add, PackageManager.add_with_mason, and PackageManager.add_with_treesitter, defined in lua/utils/package_manager.lua.

thrift.lua calls PackageManager.add_with_mason and PackageManager.add_with_treesitter, defined in lua/utils/package_manager.lua.

yaml.lua's before_init function calls pcall(require, 'schemastore') to extend YAML schemas. While schemastore is an external dependency, the require pattern follows the lua/utils module convention.

Both rust.lua and r.lua use require('utils').gh for GitHub plugin URLs, share the PackageManager.add pattern with dependencies, and both register neotest tester adapters (rustaceanvim.neotest and neotest-testthat respectively) for their language ecosystems.

Both files register oxlint via mason and configure it as a linter. typescript.lua configures oxlint for js/ts/json/vue/svelte/astro filetypes while tailwind.lua configures tailwindcss LSP that also handles typescript/typescriptreact filetypes. They share the prettierd formatter and oxlint tooling ecosystem.

Both files register prettierd formatter and oxlint linter via mason. typescript.lua's oxlint LSP config includes svelte filetype, and svelte.lua registers the same tools for svelte. They share the oxlint/oxfmt/prettierd toolchain.

Both files register prettierd formatter via mason. tailwind.lua's tailwindcss LSP config includes svelte filetype, and svelte.lua configures the svelte LSP. They share the prettierd formatting toolchain for web frontend filetypes.

Both files handle web frontend languages. tailwind.lua's tailwindcss LSP supports vue filetype, and vue.lua configures vue_ls with treesitter parsers for vue and css. They share the css/vue ecosystem.

Both files register debug adapters via mason (debugpy for Python, codelldb for Rust) and use PackageManager.add_debugger. They both also register linters (ruff/mypy/flake8 for Python, clippy for Rust) and formatters (ruff for Python, rustfmt for Rust), following the same tooling registration pattern.

Both files implement conditional LSP selection via vim.g variables (vim.g.lazyvim_php_lsp for PHP, vim.g.ruby_lsp for Ruby). Both register formatters and linters via mason (php-cs-fixer/phpcs for PHP, rubocop/standardrb for Ruby) and follow the same pattern of Gemfile/composer.json root markers.

Both files configure LSP servers that use toml configuration files. terraform.lua configures terraformls which reads .terraform directories and terraform.toml, while toml.lua configures taplo LSP with .taplo.toml/taplo.toml root markers. Both add treesitter parsers and formatters for their respective languages.

Both files use require('utils').gh for GitHub plugin URLs and register neotest-compatible test adapters. sql.lua registers vim-dadbod ecosystem while r.lua registers neotest-testthat. Both use the PackageManager.add pattern with dependencies and filetype-triggered loading.

Both files use require('utils').gh for GitHub plugin URLs, register plugins with dependencies via PackageManager.add, and configure LSP servers with detailed settings. scala.lua configures metals with autocmd-based initialization while rust.lua configures rustaceanvim with deep-extended global settings.

Both files configure LSP servers for data serialization formats (yaml-language-server and taplo). Both use root_markers for config files, add treesitter parsers, and enable LSP servers. They are part of the same data-format language support set in the nvim-config.

Both files register formatters and LSP servers for markup/template languages. xml.lua configures lemminx for xml/xsd/xsl/xslt/svg with xmlformatter, while twig.lua configures twiggy-language-server for twig/html.twig with twig-cs-fixer and twigcs. Both add treesitter parsers and follow the same mason registration pattern.

Both files configure compilers as LSP servers. solidity.lua uses solc --lsp as the LSP cmd, while rust.lua configures rust-analyzer as the LSP backend for rustaceanvim. Both register formatters (forge_fmt for Solidity, rustfmt for Rust) and linters via mason.

Both files configure LSP servers for functional/compiled languages with multiple filetypes. ocaml.lua handles ocaml/ocaml.interface/reason/dune while scala.lua handles scala/sbt. Both add treesitter parsers and use root_markers for project detection.

Both files configure LSP servers for systems programming languages. ols for Odin and zls for Zig. Both register via mason, add treesitter parsers, and are relatively minimal configurations compared to the heavier language plugins.

Both files configure LSP servers for DSL/domain-specific languages. prismals for Prisma schema and twiggy-language-server for Twig templates. Both use mason for registration, add treesitter parsers, and have minimal configuration.

Both files configure LSP servers for policy/IDL languages. regols/regal for Rego (OPA policy) and thriftls for Thrift IDL. Both register via mason, add treesitter parsers, and have minimal configuration with single-filetype focus.

Both files configure LSP servers for document preparation/publishing languages. texlab for LaTeX/TeX and tinymist for Typst. Both register formatters (vimtex/tectonic for LaTeX, typstyle for Typst), add treesitter parsers, and use mason for tool registration.

Both files register LSP servers, formatters, and linters via mason. python.lua configures pyright/ruff with debugpy debugger, while sql.lua configures sqls with sqlfluff formatter/linter. Both use the full PackageManager tooling API (add_with_mason, add_formatter, add_linter, add_debugger, add_snippets, add_with_treesitter).

Both files are part of the PHP/web templating ecosystem. php.lua configures phpactor/intelephense for PHP files while twig.lua configures twiggy-language-server for Twig templates (which are used with PHP). Both register formatters (php-cs-fixer for PHP, twig-cs-fixer for Twig) and linters (phpcs for PHP, twigcs for Twig) via mason.

Both files configure LSP servers with detailed settings objects. typescript.lua configures ts_ls with inlayHints settings while terraform.lua configures terraformls. Both register formatters and linters via mason and add treesitter parsers.

layers.name: Bootstrap / Entry Point
layers.description: Top-level startup sequence that orchestrates loading of all subsystems in dependency order. Sets the colorscheme and wires together utils, core config, plugin loader, and package manager.

layers.name: Core Editor Configuration
layers.description: Foundational Neovim editor settings that run before any plugin loads. Covers editor options, key mappings, and autocommands — the base behavior of the editor itself.

layers.name: Utility / Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Shared infrastructure modules providing cross-cutting concerns: plugin installation, package management, plugin loading, root detection, terminal helpers, treesitter helpers, and autocommand utilities.

layers.name: Plugin Configuration Layer
layers.description: Per-plugin Lua configuration files that set up, configure, and keymap each bundled Neovim plugin. This is the largest layer — 60+ configuration files.

layers.name: Language Support Sub-layer
layers.description: Per-language configuration files under lua/plugins/lang/ that register LSP servers, formatters, linters, debuggers, and tree-sitter parsers for each supported programming language.

layers.name: Configuration Tooling Layer
layers.description: Development tooling and editor configuration files that support the Lua development environment for this Neovim config.

layers.name: Documentation Layer
layers.description: Project documentation files providing user-facing and contributor-facing information.

layers.name: Runtime Data Layer
layers.description: Persistent runtime data stored outside the source tree. Includes the shared editor history archive and other runtime state.

layers.name: Health Check / Diagnostics Layer
layers.description: Validation and monitoring modules that check the editor's health and provide status information.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the project's purpose — an opinionated Neovim configuration built around 118 plugins managed by nvim-pack. CONTRIBUTING.md provides onboarding instructions for contributors.

tour.title: The Entry Point: init.lua
tour.description: The root of the entire configuration tree. init.lua orchestrates the startup sequence: it loads the utils module, config submodules (options, keymaps, autocmds), initializes the plugin loader and package manager, and sets the colorscheme to shades-of-purple. Understanding how init.lua wires together subsystems is the key to the project architecture.

tour.title: Core Editor Configuration
tour.description: Foundational Neovim settings that run before any plugin loads. options.lua sets editor preferences (backspace, clipboard, treesitter folding, smooth scrolling), keymaps.lua defines 50+ keybindings across all modes, and autocmds.lua configures autoreload, filetype-specific conceallevel, and cursorline behavior. These three modules establish the base editor behavior all plugins build upon.

tour.title: The Utils Hub: Shared Infrastructure
tour.description: The central API layer that all plugin configurations depend on. package_manager.lua exposes the global PackageManager class with methods for adding LSP servers, formatters, linters, debuggers, treesitter parsers, and snippets — used by 40+ language support files. plugins_loader.lua dynamically discovers and loads all lua/plugins/*.lua files. root.lua provides project root detection. This layer is the foundation upon which the entire plugin ecosystem is built.

tour.title: Core Framework: Snacks.nvim
tour.description: Snacks is the central UI framework that integrates with most other plugins. 00-snacks.lua configures bigfile, indent, input, notifier, scope, scroll, statuscolumn, toggle, and words modules, plus picker, dashboard, and 40+ keymaps. Gitsigns, actions-preview, dap, neo-tree, and flash all depend on it. This file is the integration point for the entire plugin ecosystem.

tour.title: Plugin Configuration Ecosystem
tour.description: Per-plugin setup files that configure, keymap, and integrate each bundled Neovim plugin. Key examples: blink.lua (completion with colorful-menu integration), conform.lua (format-on-save with toggleable behavior), gitsigns.lua (15 keybindings for hunk navigation and staging), mason.lua (LSP installer), lualine.lua (custom statusline with DAP and git sections), and whichkey.lua (leader-key popup). Each file typically calls the plugin's setup function and registers keybindings.

tour.title: Language Support Pattern
tour.description: Forty language configuration files under lua/plugins/lang/ all follow the same registration pattern: register tools via mason (PackageManager.add_with_mason), configure the LSP server with filetype and root markers, add formatters/linters/debuggers, install treesitter parsers (PackageManager.add_with_treesitter), and enable the LSP. The TypeScript exemplar shows the full pattern with oxlint, oxfmt, prettierd, js-debug-adapter, and ts_ls. Python, Rust, Go, Java, and Ruby showcase variations including conditional LSP selection and neotest integration.

tour.title: LSP Core Configuration
tour.description: lsp.lua configures Vim LSP diagnostics display, client capabilities, and on-attach keybindings for code navigation, references, code actions, and diagnostics. It uses utils, vim, and Snacks modules. This is the central LSP setup that all 40 language configurations build upon — each language file registers its specific LSP server here.

tour.title: Development Tooling
tour.description: The Lua development environment that supports editing all source files. .luarc.json configures the Lua Language Server (lua_ls) with workspace libraries and declared globals. selene.toml sets linting rules for the vim Lua dialect. stylua.toml configures the formatter (160 column width, sorted requires). vim.yml declares typed globals for the Lua runtime. nvim-pack-lock.json is the authoritative manifest pinning all 118 bundled plugins.

tour.title: Documentation & Keymaps
tour.description: KEYMAP.md is a comprehensive keymap reference organized by category — movement, window, editing, search, files, diagnostics, LSP, Snacks picker, Git, terminal, and more. LSP_CONFIG.md catalogs approximately 400 language servers with their cmd, filetypes, root_markers, and settings. The leader key is comma.

tour.title: Health Check & Diagnostics
tour.description: health.lua validates the editor's health — checks Neovim version (0.12+), verifies required external executables (git, make, unzip, rg), and reports system information via the vim.health API. lua/lualine/components/pack.lua is a statusline component showing an animated spinner during package checking and a pending update count when packages are outdated.

tour.title: Runtime Data
tour.description: The shared data archive (.local/nvim/shada/main.shada) stores persistent editor state across sessions — command history, search history, registers, marks, and bookmarks. This binary file is part of Neovim's shada (shared history) system and is read/written automatically by the editor.
